name: FMC Anglo America 2023

venue.name: Multiple Cities
venue.details: See the locations tab for more information about venue locations

information:
The competition will be held in multiple locations, across Anglo America. Please pay attention to the **time zone** of your location!

Locations may be added until **Monday, February 13th 11:59 EST**, so if there isn't a location near you yet contact your local [Delegate](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates) in Anglo America.
